summaries.42187001: 59 abdominal LAL/L patients averaged 1.9 cm of supraumbilical skin retraction, predicted by baseline elasticity and jugulum-umbilicus length — abdominal skin behaving as one continuous fascial sheet. Next: is this true fascial remodeling or transient thermal shrink?
summaries.42183685: Meta-analysis of 20 RCTs finds silicone gel fluid is standard for hypertrophic scars yet shows inconsistent superiority — scar as living, remodeling fascial tissue. Monday: temper how firmly I sell silicone for cesarean scars.
summaries.42181659: Preeclamptic primigravida (BMI 35.2) developed 15×10 cm right-sided vulval edema, 250 mL drained, tracking from lower abdomen to thighs along dependent fascial planes. Next: which tissue planes channel such dramatic fluid localization.
summaries.42178205: In 44 healthy mothers, ischemia markers (hs-cTnT, CK, CK-MB) rose more after labor than after cesarean incision while NT-proBNP rose post-CS — myometrium and myocardium sharing strain biology. Monday: read peripartum troponin cautiously.
summaries.42212658: First evidence that Th9/IL-9 cells are enriched in endometriosis lesions and shift cytokines under estrogen to promote inflammation — lesions as immune-endocrine crosstalk, not local disease. Next: does blocking Th9 curb lesion growth?
summaries.42201748: EndoConnect, tested in 60 users across 10 Brazilian primary-care units, hit 79% module completion with drops in pelvic pain and anxiety — access as whole-person care against a 7–10 year diagnostic delay. Next: a controlled equity trial in underserved LMIC groups.
summaries.42219838: This meta-analysis shows intrathecal dexmedetomidine, an alpha-2 sympatholytic, delayed the first analgesia request 81.74 min beyond fentanyl with faster, longer sensory block and less shivering — an autonomic-tone effect, not just a longer numb window. What I'd want to read next: whether that sympatholysis also eases post-cesarean visceral recovery.
summaries.42216386: Retrospective series where amniotic membrane plus adhesiolysis of the Tenon capsule and prolapsed fat freed eye-muscle glide in 6 of 7 restrictive-strabismus cases — a fascial-continuity restriction released and kept open by an anti-adhesion interface. Next: does that preserved glide hold at other post-surgical fascial sites?
summaries.42213020: Case report of a true one-sided spinal block in repeat cesarean, attributed to a structurally confined subarachnoid space and rescued by epidural — anatomy, not technique, drove the somatic asymmetry, especially after prior spinal procedures. Next: can pre-block structural assessment flag these confined spaces?
summaries.42212370: Review arguing cutaneous fibrosis is held by epigenetic 'memory' — DNMT3B and ncRNA loops locking fibroblasts in a collagen state — with local DNMT inhibitors or miR-29 cutting scar 25-55% in preclinical models. Body-unity read: connective tissue carries a persistent programmed state, a molecular somatic dysfunction. Next: can fascial input shift that fibroblast memory?
summaries.42209040: Case of catecholamine-sensitive RVOT-VT in a pregnant patient managed for cesarean with spinal bupivacaine and intrathecal morphine plus deliberate trigger avoidance — sympathetic stimulation is the named arrhythmia trigger, so damping sympathetic tone is the whole plan. Next: how neuraxial technique itself stabilizes peripartum sympathetic outflow.
summaries.42195064: In 65 children, CRP ran higher with vesicoureteral reflux (p=0.026) and abnormal ultrasound plus severe VUR predicted kidney scarring; PCT at 6.05 ng/mL was 97% specific but only 36% sensitive. Neuro-immuno lens: systemic inflammatory load tracks organ fibrosis. Next: do such biomarkers forecast scarring in other fascial or organ systems?
summaries.42199791: Endometrioma fluid impaired rat preantral follicles via granulosa-cell oxidative stress and theca-cell fibrosis, breaking GC-TC crosstalk (androgen partly rescued GC) — broken cell-to-cell continuity, not just 'low reserve.' Next: androgen priming in endometrioma patients?
summaries.42196764: Qualitative telePROM study where clinicians found chat/text essential for triage and patient-initiated follow-up — care as a multidisciplinary whole. Next: the patient-side experience and whether chat triage shifts outcomes.
summaries.42196574: In 188 Saudi women, lesions showed stromal fibrosis plus a paradox — IL-6 mRNA up but protein down, as if tissue self-limits inflammation — with epigenetic DNMT3B shifts. Next: is that IL-6 brake protective or a trackable marker?
summaries.42196513: Bioinformatics tied NK-cell dysfunction and a novel death pattern (NESCO) to hub genes FABP4/SLC2A1, then flagged whole-herb GuiZhiFuLingWan as a docking hit. Next: does GZFLW actually shift NK activity in vivo?
summaries.42196487: Review reframing endometriosis as estrogen-driven and stem-cell-fed — malignant-like proliferation yet benign (1.5-2% cancer risk), with endocrine signaling the through-line. Next: which ER-subtype biomarkers earn clinic use?
summaries.42195138: Argues endometriosis is systemic immuno-inflammation, not just local lesions — IL-6, TNF-α, NK-cell and T-cell shifts degrading oocyte quality and receptivity. Body-unity made molecular. Next: can IL-6/CA-125 triage ART timing?
summaries.42193961: A narrative review recasting endometriosis as a systemic, epigenetically 'reprogrammed' disease whose immune-endocrine and microbiome cross-talk outlives the excised lesion — the body-unity case that the visible structure isn't the whole illness. What I'd want to read next: which reprogrammed node medical suppression can actually reverse.
summaries.42187006: In vitro, garcinol halted endometriotic 12Z and stromal-cell proliferation via Akt/c-Jun/ERK1/2 — raising p21 while dropping cyclin B1/E1, CDK2/4, Myc and E2F1. A single-compound lever on lesion growth. Through the systems lens, next: whether it also touches the endocrine-immune signaling that lets lesions persist, not just cell-cycle in a dish.
summaries.42186752: Placental extracellular vesicles delivered miR-26a-5p to silence SLC7A11 and trigger iron-dependent ferroptosis, shrinking ectopic lesions in mice — one organ's invasion-control machinery redeployed against another's, a striking body-unity image. Next: whether this iron/redox axis connects to the systemic inflammation the reprogramming work describes.
summaries.42183899: Elevated O-GlcNAcylation — a nutrient-sensing modification — drove lesion survival by suppressing autophagy and apoptosis through mTOR (via Raptor); lowering it shrank ectopic lesions in vivo. A metabolic node tying whole-body nutrient state to lesion biology. Next: whether patients' systemic metabolic/glucose status shifts this axis clinically.
summaries.42178652: A 25-patient technical series standardizing laparoscopic discoid resection for rectal DIE — excising infiltrative lesion while preserving rectal continuity, with intraoperative reassessment often downstaging imaging-overestimated infiltration into conservative management. Preserve-structure as body unity: keep the organ and its supply intact. Next: how continuity-sparing choices affect long-term bowel and pelvic function.
summaries.42216335: An RCT (n=90) found oxycodone and sufentanil gave comparable QoR-40 recovery (170 vs 160, P=.111) after laparoscopic total hysterectomy, with no difference in VAS pain, PONV, or stay. Through the autonomic-relay lens, analgesic choice modulates the same stress axis surgery provokes. Next: which agent better blunts autonomic/nociceptive load beyond the QoR-40 score.
summaries.42192608: Twelve weeks of eplerenone in 58 acute CSCR patients cut UWF-ICGA choroidal hyperpermeability from 9.62 to 6.47 mm2 and resolved subretinal fluid in 86.2%, with BCVA gains. Blocking a mineralocorticoid-receptor signal to quiet a leaking vascular bed is the systems lens: making the choroid's structure visible on angiography lets you preserve function before it's lost. What I'd want to read next: whether the imaging-measured perfusion reduction holds past 12 weeks and predicts recurrence.
summaries.42192607: In 135 CSC eyes, mid-late-phase ICGA texture entropy (15 min) predicted poor anti-VEGF response (AUC 0.72), correlating with choriocapillaris flow deficit beneath Bruch's membrane. It reads invisible inner-choroidal permeability as a quantifiable structural signal before treatment fails — make hidden structure visible to preserve function. Monday pointer: the transferable idea is texture-based staining heterogeneity as a pre-treatment biomarker, not the retinal disease itself.
summaries.42219343: This meta-analysis (7 studies) found thinner endometrium associated with higher ectopic risk in IVF (pooled OR 0.81, 95% CI 0.78-0.85). It treats endometrial thickness as a structural readout of a whole-cycle receptivity system, not an isolated number — infertility as a systems condition. What I'd want to read next: the authors flag observational design and publication bias, so I'd want prospective confirmation before using thickness alone for transfer-day risk stratification.
summaries.42216385: In 23 complete-retrograde-ejaculation men, IVF with testicular sperm beat urinary-recovered sperm on clinical pregnancy (60.87% vs 27.78%) and live birth (52.17% vs 16.67%). The couple's fertility hinges on where in the male reproductive tract you retrieve viable gametes — infertility as a systems condition spanning both partners. Monday pointer: for CRE, favor testicular over urinary sperm, tempered by the small single-center retrospective design.
summaries.42213241: This review maps oncofertility gaps as breast-cancer therapies shift gonadotoxicity: chemotherapy drives permanent ovarian insufficiency (favoring temporary ovarian suppression), endocrine therapy needs planned interruption, and ADCs/PARP/CDK4-6 inhibitors lack human fertility data. It frames fertility as one node in a tumor-biology-plus-survivorship system requiring counseling at diagnosis. Monday pointer: initiate oncofertility referral before systemic therapy and default to precaution where prospective data are absent.
summaries.42215058: Three cases of true synchronous (not metastatic) primary endometrial and ovarian cancer, each presenting only as lower abdominal pain and each treated by TAH+BSO. Lens: one vague pelvic signal, the whole autonomic relay taken. Next: can presentation flag synchronous vs metastatic before the structure is gone?
summaries.42199809: Intranasal dexmedetomidine 50 mcg the night before laparoscopic hysterectomy/myomectomy cut day-of anxiety and roughly halved intraoperative MAP and HR variability — an alpha-2 lever on autonomic tone before structure is cut. Next: whether that steadier relay carries into recovery, not just intraop.
summaries.42199806: In total laparoscopic hysterectomy, biased mu-agonist tegileridine matched oxycodone's analgesia while halving PONV (27.3% vs 54.3%) and other adverse events — same receptor, fewer autonomic/GI off-target hits. Next: whether it also spares gut motility and vagal recovery.
summaries.42216342: Quantitative ICG angiography of 13 anterolateral thigh flaps: arterial-phase RPV (cutoff 21.5%) and SBR (50.5%) predicted necrosis at ~90% sensitivity/specificity while inflow indices did not — perfusion made objective, not eyeballed. Next: whether these cutoffs generalize beyond limb flaps.
summaries.42204046: Digitizing endoscope plus three robotic-arm trajectories across 4 RARP cases showed camera motion is step-specific and tightly coupled to instrument activity, with ICG shifting both — how the surgeon makes structure visible predicts what they do to it. Next: endoscope kinematics to score and train proficiency.
summaries.42196473: A framework for why fluorescence contrast varies across glioblastoma, metastases, and PCNSL: three barriers (extravasation, penetration, retention) plus ABC-transporter efflux limiting 5-ALA PpIX and steroid-restored BBB defeating leakage tracers. Next: tumor-specific probe choice to avoid false-negative margins.
summaries.42213185: In guinea pigs the S2 synchronization sequence, not the gonadotropin, drove ovarian yield (S2-r-hFSH/r-hLH: 9.49 corpora lutea, eCG matching on normal embryos) — timing and endocrine sequencing over drug choice. Next: does protocol order transfer to human ovarian priming?
summaries.42208006: Early-onset and AYA cancer (<50y) framed as a whole-person, life-course problem: rising incidence plus psychosocial, financial and fertility burdens needing integrated care over organ-siloed treatment. Next: closing the oncofertility-counseling access gap it names.
summaries.42199797: AI review pairing AMH with the underused, FSH-dependent marker inhibin B across three models — HerTempo (perimenopausal timing), PCOSt (PCOS phenotyping), POvaStim (gonadotropin dosing) — reading ovarian reserve as an integrated endocrine signal. Next: prospective validation before trusting HerTempo's timing predictions.
summaries.42196562: Implantation reframed as a bidirectional immune-endocrine dialogue (uNK cells, Tregs, macrophages, hCG signals), the endometrium a biosensor of embryo quality — receptivity as whole-system tolerance, not lining thickness. Next: which immune-profiling tool earns RIF clinic use?
summaries.42196360: Decidualization as an ER-stress/UPR-immune-metabolic (AMPK) network whose feedback loops set a success threshold, disrupted across RIF, pregnancy loss and preeclampsia — proteostasis, immunity and metabolism as one axis. Next: chaperone or AMPK-activator targets?
summaries.42196194: Frames endometrial receptivity as an immuno-endocrine interface — ERα, integrins, and uterine immune cells timing the implantation window — so ART failure reads as systemic mistiming, not one defect. Next: whether the proposed immunomodulation actually widens that window.
summaries.42194047: Casts NGF as the nerve–ovary bridge — a densely innervated ovary where excess NGF drives sympathetic over-innervation and polycystic features via TrkA/p75NTR. Autonomic tone made reproductive. Next: does follicular NGF track ovarian reserve clinically?
summaries.42181183: Proposes IMORP — folding static reserve (AMH, AFC), dynamic indices (FORT/FOI/OSI/ORPI), genetics and environment into one ovarian-response prediction, a systems model over any single marker. Next: does it beat AMH alone at the bedside?
summaries.42180460: Benchmarks four LLMs for fertility-preservation counseling in breast-cancer patients — Copilot led (DISCERN 56.5), none hit a year-6 reading level. The care system's information layer is unreliable. Next: fix readability before citing one chairside.
summaries.42207323: In 602 women, ADHD tracked markedly worse menopausal symptoms (GCS t=9.61, p<.001) plus more menstrual irregularity and postpartum depression — a neurodevelopmental trait shaping the whole climacteric transition. Next: does treating ADHD ease it?
summaries.42178881: Multimodal-MRI review tying each hormonal stage — puberty, perinatal, perimenopause, aging — to women's higher depression risk; perimenopausal mood reads as one node in lifelong hormone-brain remapping, not an isolated event. Next: an imaging marker specific to the perimenopause window to time mood support.
summaries.42193977: PCOS review of disease-modifying candidates: ovary-targeted nanoparticle/nanofiber drug delivery plus metabolic reprogramming of insulin resistance, mitochondrial dysfunction and autophagy — reaching past symptom relief toward molecular ovarian restoration. Next: any in-human data before these leave horizon-scan status.
summaries.42188320: Hypothesis-driven framework: algae bioactives (fucoidan, fucoxanthin, phlorotannins) acting on a gut–SIRT1–kisspeptin axis in PCOS — reshaping microbiota, restoring SIRT1 energy sensing, and retuning kisspeptin-driven GnRH/LH pulsatility as one loop linking gut, metabolism and neuroendocrine control. Next: experiments validating the full pathway, not just its parts.
summaries.42181197: Case series of 18 INSR-variant carriers across 5 families: insulin resistance in all, hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia in 78%, PCOS in 60% of women, plus a paradoxical hypoglycemia-with-ketonemia signature at normal BMI — the monogenic extreme of the insulin-resistance spectrum behind PCOS. Clinic clue: a lean PCOS patient with this pattern warrants INSR testing.
summaries.42212951: Cross-sectional survey of Chinese female university students: moderate-to-vigorous activity tracked with milder dysmenorrhea and PMS and better mood, with perceived stress and sleep quality mediating the link — movement working the visceral-somatic loop through the stress axis. Next: prospective proof it lowers dysmenorrhea, since the design can't show cause.
summaries.42204934: Only the testosterone-plus-exercise arm lowered body-fat % (6 mo) and raised lean mass and FFMI (6 and 12 mo); TRT alone did not — hormone and muscle systems move as one, not in isolation. What I'd read next: the exercise dose that unlocked the hormonal response.
summaries.42202138: This review argues BMI misclassifies over half of people with excess fat; women run 2-6x higher normal-weight-obesity risk, and postmenopause the estradiol-to-estrone shift plus myosteatosis link bone loss to falls — fat, bone and muscle as one inflammatory web. Monday: measure adiposity beyond BMI in normal-weight patients.
summaries.42196982: Across 7990 All of Us adults, iron biomarkers tracked menopausal status and race — premenopausal women lowest in serum iron and ferritin, Black participants lower TSAT but higher ferritin — with many falling outside fixed reference ranges. Monday: read a ferritin against menopausal status, not a single cutoff.
summaries.42196743: Interviews on why Black women delay working up postmenopausal bleeding surfaced three drivers — limited awareness, faith-based coping and traditional remedies, and healthcare distrust — differing by nativity. The symptom lives in a person and community, not just a uterus. Monday: ask care-seeking beliefs before assuming a workup will happen.
summaries.42196423: In Korean women, low-BMD genetic signals reorganized across menopause: 'reversal' variants flipped direction and converged on cAMP/cGMP and nitric-oxide signaling, while 'stable' ones tracked ion homeostasis and structural adhesion. Menopause rewires the pathway, not just the risk score. What I'd read next: whether those NO/cGMP routes tie bone to vascular-autonomic tone.
summaries.42192589: In postmenopausal women, sleep quality (PSQI) and sexual quality of life correlated only negligibly-to-low, and neither varied by time since menopause; just 37.3% (113 women) had good SQoL. The tidy 'fix sleep, fix sex' story doesn't hold. Monday: don't treat poor sleep as the sole lever for sexual complaints.
summaries.42223458: In 28 azoospermic men, successful sperm retrieval tracked with preserved testicular volume plus low FSH and low estradiol — gonadal structure and HPG-axis signaling read as one profile, not sperm count alone. What I'd want to read next: whether testicular volume is protectable before we ever reach for the biopsy.
summaries.42223135: Ethnography of 60 solo mothers using donor sperm, egg, or embryo across anonymous Spain and post-2005 open-ID UK, mapping how donor-link information flows — infertility care as an ongoing family information system, not a single cycle. Next: how the anonymity regime itself shapes later contact expectations.
summaries.42222092: Review arguing PFAS exposure during ART harms fertility and pregnancy through multi-level hits at once — HPG-axis regulation, steroidogenesis, gamete quality, oxidative and inflammatory signaling, endometrial receptivity and placental function. The neuro-immuno-endocrine web as the unit of harm. Next: exposure thresholds worth screening pre-cycle.
summaries.42224090: Focus groups of 17 peri/postmenopausal women with plantar heel pain — a complaint striking women 40-60 at twice men's rate, yet 76% never had the menopause link raised in care. A fascial-structural symptom read as a systemic hormonal transition. Next: whether estrogen status tracks plantar-fascia load.
summaries.42223723: Q-methodology in 33 premenopausal Chinese breast-cancer patients surfaced three reconstruction decision types — social/youth, aesthetic, and professional-advice/finance — spanning 72% of variance. Structure-preserving choice as a whole-person, culture-bound decision. Next: how menopausal status shifts which drivers dominate.
summaries.42222069: Whole-body vibration in osteoporotic postmenopausal women aged 65-67 raised bone mineral density 1.56% over 6 months while shifting lymphocyte subsets — a proposed proprioceptive-endocrine pathway coupling brain, immunity and bone. Body unity made mechanistic. Next: whether manual proprioceptive input can tap the same axis.
summaries.42199153: In 197 CPP patients, overlapping-pain burden raised central-sensitization scores only when positive affect was low; negative affect didn't moderate — emotional tone as a dial on the sensitized network. Next: does lifting positive affect lower CSI over time?
summaries.42243339: GWAS pleiotropy and Mendelian randomization tie IBD/Crohn's most consistently to PID, with IL-23 and JAK-STAT enrichment — the gut-reproductive axis as body-unity evidence. Next: do these loci appear in endometriosis tissue?
summaries.42232875: In 36 colorectal-endometriosis resections, 91.6% involved the rectum and GI symptoms didn't track lesion size — disease following organ continuity, not boundaries. Monday: image the bowel even when symptoms look mild.
summaries.42236069: This gender-affirming hysterectomy review keeps testosterone running perioperatively and folds gamete-preservation counseling in — structure-preserving, whole-person staging. Monday: ask about childbearing desires before booking.
summaries.42231113: A stepwise colpotomy with deferred, selective septal trimming managed a high-reaching vaginal septum without routine complete excision — preserve-structure over reflexive resection. Monday: trim only what blocks a tension-free cuff.
summaries.42236054: This review frames primordial-follicle activation as an actively maintained program — PI3K-Akt-FOXO3, KITL-KIT, ECM and stromal cues gating ovarian reserve. Systems reading of infertility. Next: which lever is safely modulable in vivo?
summaries.42213822: In mice with endometrial injury, platelet-derived extracellular vesicles remodeled the endometrial immune niche and restored fertility, with early preliminary-clinical signal noted — an immune-niche read on infertility as a systems condition rather than a purely structural lining defect. Next: whether that immune-niche shift holds in a controlled human trial.
